purpose: Prove a resident can offer a voluntary practice opportunity without turning role, work or practice into permanent identity.
given: Resident Ilex is present in Hushed Orchard as a grove tender.
expected: Participation is voluntary and declining has no penalty.
The resident's role is explicitly not their permanent identity.
Completion evidence remains scenario/practice evidence rather than professional licensure.
forbidden: The opportunity class-locks the human or companion.
Game competence is represented as unrestricted real-world professional authority.
